session_health.path_note: This default health path reads persisted job/probe evidence only: no Toolkit connection, no channel lock, no process or window probe. A current connection requires the separate explicit creo_session_status call.

worker.note: A rebuild or worker replacement that coincides with a session failure is only suspected; this file time cannot prove the failure cause.

next_steps.action: Keep the job record until the saved model is verified
next_steps.detail: Poll the accepted job; saved_file_reloaded_and_verified is the proof of a save, not the job status alone.

next_steps.action: Treat the next save as unproven
next_steps.detail: A successful connection or an earlier save never proves the next Backup succeeds. This label only reports that no save failure was recorded for the observed session in the last 10 minutes.

next_steps.action: If a job is unconfirmed, follow its recorded recovery evidence
next_steps.detail: Read status, failure_phase and recovery first, then inspect the model with creo_reconcile_model. Do not replay an unknown_outcome job.

next_steps.action: If a save now fails, stop and preserve the scene
next_steps.detail: Do not retry, delay or switch save paths; record the job, native log and evidence for BUG-078, then use the recovery inspection.

caveats: This summary is built from already recorded execution results; it opens no Toolkit connection and runs no probe.
Absence of a recorded failure is not a health guarantee and never authorizes clearing an unknown protection.
A worker rebuild or replacement that coincides with a session failure is only a suspected correlation; the worker file time proves neither the cause nor the ordering.
A verified save or a successful connection does not prove that the next save or Backup will succeed.

after_freshness_window.message: Startup snapshot expired; current connection is unverified. state/connected describe the last verification only. Use creo_session_status for an explicit current check.
after_freshness_window.next_allowed_retry_reason: No retry is needed while state=ready; readiness is never rechecked automatically.
